_comment: The AI Economic Pulse platforms for the Kingdom that Rasd sits on top of. Each is a Vercel project in the economicpulse team. 'feeds' lists what the situation picture takes from it today (refreshed daily by scripts/refresh-ksa-data.mjs, or live at request time) and what would still add to the picture.

modules.name: Hormuz FoodWatch
modules.summary: 154 food products tracked daily across Saudi retail sources; weekly non-core CPI by category; source-country → route → category flows; Hormuz exposure per product with Hormuz-free alternatives; executive brief; AI CPI advisor.

live: weekly non-core CPI by category (base 100), food index and CPI overall → panel 01
tracked retail basket (171 products: weight, origin, raw material, Hormuz flag) → panel 01 basket exposure
UN Comtrade 2024 Hormuz exposure per HS6 (critical + top-200 lists, alternatives, corridors) → panel 02
to_wire: out-of-stock detection in the retail price scraper (available:false per SKU × retailer) → stock-outs

modules.name: KSA Macroeconomic Pulse
modules.summary: Weekly GDP tracker (total, oil, non-oil), twelve indicators (Brent, port calls, TASI, SAMA rate, PMI, employment, spending, investment confidence), daily press sentiment, AI macro advisor.

live: weekly GDP nowcast (total, oil, non-oil), Brent, TASI, SAMA rate, PMI, port calls, spending, employment, investment → panels 02–04
/api/news-sentiment → daily pooled sentiment score, band, headlines (live at request time) → panel 03
to_wire: /api/oil-price → daily Brent (currently failing: model ID claude-sonnet-4-20250514 no longer exists — update the model string)

modules.name: GCC Shipping Intelligence
modules.summary: GCC import supply chains and Hormuz chokepoint exposure across the six states; optimal and alternative routes; rerouting cost and transit comparisons.

to_wire: /api/ksa-routes → inbound vessels bound for Saudi ports by type and ETA; days of supply at Gulf and Red Sea ports

modules.name: KSA Stocks Analytics
modules.summary: Research engine for the Saudi Exchange: company financials, peer comparisons, sector dynamics, screens, Arabic and English.

to_wire: /api/market-latest → TASI daily change, sector moves, breadth (the weekly TASI already comes from the macro series)

modules.name: Jamarik — Saudi customs mirror
modules.summary: Trade-mirror forensics for the Kingdom: what every exporting partner reports shipping to Saudi Arabia against what the Kingdom registers, product by product — the origin-adjusted dependence and supplier-concentration view behind the supply panel. Monthly cadence.

to_wire: /api/ksa-dependence → import dependence and origin-adjusted supplier concentration for the forty food headings
